title: Easy Going Spanish Spaghetti Pasta
description: A lazy Sunday Spanish dish featuring spaghetti, simmered in a rich and resinous tomato sauce, perfect for a gluten-free friendly meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the canned tomatoes and chicken broth to the skillet, stirring to combine, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and reduced slightly.
When the spaghetti is done cooking, drain it and add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce, tossing to combine.
Transfer the spaghetti to a serving dish and top with grated manchego cheese.
Serve the spaghetti hot, garnished with additional smoked paprika if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
